action_grid_extension: Revision 15c adds 1.7x and 1.9x coefficient targets; demand and supply calibration are unchanged and RL warm start is disabled.

source.title: List, Muir, Pope & Sun, Left-Digit Bias at Lyft (2023)
source.estimate: Standard-product conversion elasticity about -0.9 to -1.4; Shared -1.7 to -3.3
source.context: US Lyft price-offer experiments; other options held fixed, not total market demand

limitations: Transferred Lyft Standard conversion prior, not a city-specific causal estimate.
Anchor participation and non-price utilities retain existing contextual priors; they are not validated by fitting elasticity.
Relative inverse GPT thresholds are a heterogeneity prior, not observed willingness to pay.
Conditional logit substitution (IIA) is assumed, not identified by the single own-price moment.
Request opportunities are fixed: app-entry, long-run market expansion and equilibrium supply are not identified.
No reward, constant-tariff optimum or RL performance enters calibration or parameter selection.
evidence.fitting: exact local own-price log derivative at parity

warm_start_selection.hindsight_scope: best evaluated static/oracle/schedule complete trajectory per opening; excludes RL and online myopic search; not global dynamic optimum
warm_start_selection.uncertainty_unit: independent opening within rival, not market blocks; hindsight selection optimism remains
